# SYNTHETIC. Reproduces the real corpus's TWO spellings of the same potentials:
# `<digits>mV` in most acquisitions, and a `p`-decimal volt form
# (`1p2V` = 1.2 V) in others — the same scientist, the same week. A reader that
# normalises only one of them silently reports half the corpus's potentials.
# Also reproduces the lowercase `mv` a MERGE product uses.
#
# millivolt form
20_02_ZZ2_base_after1500Cycling_filter10_1200mV
21_02_ZZ2_base_after1500Cycling_filter10_1500mV
22_02_ZZ2_base_after1500Cycling_filter10_1800mV
# p-decimal volt form, the SAME magnitudes
20_02_ZZ2_base_after1500Cycling_filter10_1p2V
21_02_ZZ2_base_after1500Cycling_filter10_1p5V
22_02_ZZ2_base_after1500Cycling_filter10_1p8V
# lowercase unit, as a MERGE product writes it
ave_ZZ2_filter10_1600mv
# a zero-padded magnitude, which must not become 60 V
03_01_ZZ1_acid_beforeCycling_060mV_filter10
